_doc: One entry per figure. Use `at` (seconds into --video) OR `src` (an image path relative to this file). Marker x/y are fractions of the REGION, measured before blur/taskbar/trim.

figures._region: share = meeting recording. Also: full | window | [x,y,w,h] fractions.
figures._blur: Screen-share pill, names, emails. Fractions [x0,y0,x1,y1] of the region.
figures._markers: dir places the badge relative to the target: ul, ur, dl, dr. It auto-flips near an edge.
